text: The Systematic Observations Financing Facility (SOFF) is a United Nations Multi-Partner Trust Fund established to address the global gap in surface-based weather and climate observations, with a focus on Least Developed Countries (LDCs) and Small Island Developing States (SIDS). It aims to enhance early warning systems and climate monitoring by ensuring compliance with the Global Basic Observing Network (GBON) standards. SOFF provides long-term financing, peer advisory, and leverages complementary climate finance to support infrastructure, capacity building, and data sharing.
